description: Returns per-past-run accuracy for a forecast. Each row compares a prior run's projection against the actuals that have materialized since. Use this to see whether your forecasts have been getting MORE or LESS accurate over time, or to spot when a backtest sMAPE was systematically optimistic vs. realised performance.
name: get_forecast_trust

runs.description: Per-past-run accuracy ordered oldest-first. Each row compares one prior run's forecast against actuals that have since materialized.

observed_count.description: How many of the forecast points now have an actual observation to compare against.

smape_actual.description: sMAPE between the run's forecast and what actually happened. Lower is better; [0, 200].

smape_backtest.description: The run's own backtest sMAPE at the time it was generated. Compare against actual to spot drift over time.
